response.sql: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM project_rates) SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.rate, pr.rate - b.rate AS gap FROM project_rates AS pr CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE pr.rate > b.rate ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A project's rate is its total scan size divided by its total scan duration; scans with missing size or nonpositive duration are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: A project's rate is the plain average of its individual scan rates.
